label: Personal emails in public history
means: Distinct author emails, on every branch of each public repo, that are neither GitHub noreply nor the org's domain.
goal_source: Owner decision, 2026-11-24: public history is not rewritten to remove an author email. That would need a force push to main. The goal stays 0, so each miss stays visible. Template source: GitHub Docs, Setting your commit email address (read 2026-11-19).
source: gh api --paginate repos/<repo>/branches, then every commit of each branch, every page, of every public repo (collectors/visibility/visibility.mjs); detail counts per repo and the forks of those repos, never an address
